news.title: WashU- and Vanderbilt-commissioned report on the humanities comes under fire
news.summary_en: A recent report commissioned by WashU and Vanderbilt on the politicization of humanities research has generated significant pushback from humanities professors, the WashU chapter of the American Association of University Professors (AAUP), and the Director of the WashU Center for the Humanities, among others.
news.author: Lexi Lawsky
